question: The literacy rate of Andhra Pradesh state as per the Census of 2011 is _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**67.02%**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• With a **literacy rate** of approximately** 67.02%**, it suggests that out of every 100 individuals aged seven and above in Andhra Pradesh, about 67 were literate, meaning they possessed the ability to read and write with understanding.
 
• Andhra Pradesh's population, according to data from the 2011 Census, is 8.46 crore, up from 7.62 crore in the 2001 Census. As to the latest census data, Andhra Pradesh has a total population of 84,580,777, with 42,442,146 males and 42,138,631 females, respectively.
 
• Andhra Pradesh has a lower sex ratio than the national average of 940, with 993 females for every 1000 males, according to the most recent census. In Andhra Pradesh in 2001, there were 978 females for every 1000 males. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• According to the **2011 Indian Census, Andhra Pradesh's literacy rate** is the proportion of the state's population that is seven years of age or older and can read and write in any language with comprehension.
 
• According to the **2011 census, 74.04% of Indians are literate**. Male literacy rates are 82.14% while female literacy rates are 65.46%.
